registration.title: Skill ranks: players ranked on single skills, and each position a mix of skills
registration.what: Eight skills (finishing, creating, passing, dribbling, ball-winning, duels, defensive solidity, goalkeeping), each one recipe of counted stats for every position. Each position's rank becomes a mix of skills, starting from the shares today's weights give each skill. Every outfield player gets a 0 to 100 score in each skill, for lists on the site.
registration.why: The owner wants players ranked by skill, and positions built from a mix of skills he can tune.
registration.how: SKILLS and SKILL_MIX in player_ratings.py; WEIGHTS worked out from them. Recipes by a fixed rule from today's weights (experiments/skill_ranks/DESIGN.md).
registration.hypothesis: Re-expressing the position weights as skills keeps the ranks where they are (Spearman 0.98+ per group), no less repeatable from season to season, with keepers untouched and the match model's XI ratings barely moved.
registration.success_criteria: experiments/skill_ranks/run.py: all four checks in DESIGN.md pass. The owner then tunes the mixes by eye, each tuning a change of its own.
